name: When should I consider a full kitchen lighting remodel versus just replacing fixtures?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a full kitchen lighting remodel versus just replacing fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a full kitchen lighting remodel if your current lighting layout is insufficient, poorly placed, or if you're undertaking a larger kitchen renovation. Replacing fixtures is suitable when the existing electrical infrastructure and lighting placement meet your needs, but you want an updated look or more energy-efficient bulbs. A remodel addresses fundamental issues like dark spots or lack of task lighting, while replacements focus on aesthetics and efficiency. We can help assess whether your kitchen needs a simple update or a comprehensive overhaul.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a full remodel for insufficient lighting layouts or larger renovations; replace fixtures for updated looks or energy efficiency if current layout is fine.
